rationale: As a single, young individual with no assets or dependents, a Will and Healthcare Directive are essential for ensuring her wishes are respected in the event of her passing or incapacitation.

As a 58-year-old married business owner with children and property, it is essential to have a comprehensive estate plan in place to ensure the smooth transfer of assets, business continuity, and medical wishes are respected.

As a divorced parent with children, Maria needs to ensure her children are well taken care of in the event of her passing. A Will and Power of Attorney will help her maintain control and make decisions for her children. A Healthcare Directive will also ensure her medical wishes are respected.
